about.text: award-winning, washed-rind cheese produced since 1994 by Charles Martell and Son at Hunts Court Farm, Dymock, Gloucestershire, in the south west of England.

sources.text: rind washed in perry every four weeks; Wikipedia gives about 4 months, producers often sell from 6 weeks; pasteurised Gloucester/Friesian milk
